THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)
Order under Section 4(1)
WHERE as an industrial dispute in respect of the matter/specified in the statement of the Commissioner of Labour whichaccompanies this order exists between,
Mr. K. Piyatilake, No. 199, Thakshila Garden, Munagama, Horana of the one part
and
National Gem and Jewellery Authority, No. 25, Galle Face Terrace, Colombo 03 of the other part

Now Therefore, I, Ravindra Samaraweera, Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations do by virtue of the powers vested inme by Section 4 (1) of the Industrial Disputes Act, Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon (1956 Revised Edition),as amended by Acts Nos. 14 of 1957, 4 of 1962 and 39 of 1968 (read with Industrial Disputes - Special Provisions) Act No. 37of 1968 hereby appoint.
Mr. S. Kariyawasam, No. 75, Melpitiya, Matale to be the arbitrator and refer the aforesaid dispute to him for settlementby arbitration.
RAVINDRA SAMARAWEERA,Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations.
Colombo.09th July, 2018.

THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)
Mr. K. Piyatilake, No. 199, Thakshila Garden, Munagama, Horana of the one part
and
National Gem and Jewellery Authority, No. 25, Galle Face Terrace, Colombo 03 of the other part
STATEMENT OF MATTER IN DISPUTE
The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is –

Whether Mr. K. Piyatilake who had joined the National Gem Corporation as a Junior Clerk and been promoted as a Senior Clerkand then as the Acting Project Officer, who had made a request to retire after the completion of 55 years at a time when he hadbeen absorbed into the National Gem and Jewellery Authority on a decision of the Board of Directors had been caused injusticeby the termination of his employment when he had already informed the Authority before the lapse of one month from his requestthat he withdraws the application and if such injustice had been caused, to what reliefs he is entitled.
A. WIMALAWEERA,Commissioner of Labour.
Dated at the Office of the Commissioner of Labour,Colombo this 04th day of July, 2018.

Mr. Nandasiri Lokukaluge, No. 269/2A, Ariyasinhala Mawatha, Koswatta Road, Kalapaluwawa, Rajagiriya, of theone part
and
Sri Lanka Telecom PLC, Lotus Road, Colombo 01, of the other part

Now Therefore I, Ravindra Samaraweera, Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations do by virtue of the powers vested inme by Section 4(1) of the Industrial Disputes Act, Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon (1956 Revised Edition),as amended by Act, Nos. 14 of 1957, 4 of 1962 and 39 of 1968 (read with Industrial Disputes - Special Provisions) Act, No. 37 of1968 hereby appoint Mr. S. Virithamulla, No. 128, Piriwena Road, Boralesgamuwa to be the arbitrator and refer the aforesaid disputeto him for settlement by arbitration.
RAVINDRA SAMARAWEERA,Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations.
Colombo.09th July, 2018.

THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)
Mr. Nandasiri Lokukaluge, No. 269/2A, Ariyasinhala Mawatha, Koswatta Road, Kalapaluwawa, Rajagiriya, of the one part
and
Sri Lanka Telecom PLC, Lotus Road, Colombo 01, of the other part
STATEMENT OF MATTER IN DISPUTE
The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is

Whether Mr. Nandasiri Lokukaluge who served as the Senior Executive Assistant Manager of Sri Lanka Telecom PLC had beencaused injustice by being retired with effect from 04.01.2017 on the completion of 55 years of age without being permitted aservice extension upto 60 years of age and if so, to what reliefs he is entitled.
A. WIMALAWEERA,Commissioner General of Labour.
Dated at the Office of the Commissioner of Labour,Colombo, this 04th day of July, 2018.
